# Career OS

> Mac desktop job-hunt operating system — track applications, tailor CVs, drill questions, and get a stealth coach grounded in your own CV during live interviews.

## Stack

- **Desktop shell**: Tauri 2.10 + React 19 + Vite 6 + TypeScript 5.6
- **Core**: Rust (stable) with Cargo
- **Backend**: Cloudflare Worker (TypeScript)
- **State management**: Zustand (sliced store)
- **UI**: Hand-rolled CSS tokens, Lucide icons, cmdk, dnd-kit
- **macOS bridge**: Swift sidecar (ScreenCaptureKit for audio capture)
- **STT**: Deepgram Nova-3 primary, AssemblyAI failover, whisper.cpp local
- **LLM**: Claude Sonnet 4.5+ primary, GPT-5/4o failover, Ollama local
- **Persistence**: SQLite (sqlx) + JSONL transcripts
- **Vector store**: LanceDB embedded
- **Secrets**: macOS Keychain (keyring crate)
- **CV parsing**: Docling (IBM, Python sidecar)

## Project Structure

```
src/                    Frontend React app (Dashboard, Jobs, Applications, CV Manager, Prep, Live Copilot)
  dashboard/            Main career OS surfaces
  copilot/              Live overlay app (stealth interview coach)
  teleprompter/         Teleprompter surface
src-tauri/              Rust core (audio capture, STT, LLM, persistence, cloud client)
  migrations/           SQLite schema migrations
landing/                Marketing landing page (separate Vite app)
worker/                 Cloudflare Worker backend (API, auth, Anthropic proxy)
docs/                   Operator and developer documentation
.planning/              Project planning artifacts (GSD workflow)
remotion/               Video generation (Remotion)
brand/                  Logo and brand assets
```

## Getting Started

### Prerequisites

- macOS 13+ (macOS 15+ recommended)
- Rust (stable) + Cargo
- Node 20+ and pnpm
- Xcode Command Line Tools

### Run from source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Caezarr/career-ops.git
cd career-ops
pnpm install

# Terminal 1: Worker
cd worker
cp .dev.vars.example .dev.vars   # then fill API keys
pnpm install
pnpm db:migrate:local
pnpm dev    # http://localhost:8787

# Terminal 2: App
cd ..
echo 'VITE_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8787' > .env.local
pnpm tauri dev
```

### Common commands

```bash
pnpm tauri dev      # dev with hot reload
pnpm tauri build    # produces unsigned .dmg
pnpm typecheck      # tsc -b --noEmit
pnpm build          # frontend-only build
cargo test          # Rust tests
```

## Key Design Principles

- **Privacy-first**: No raw audio persisted, all data local, single-egress cloud client
- **Zero CV hallucinations**: Citation-required prompts with post-generation validation
- **Tier-1 reliability**: Dual-vendor failover (STT + LLM) + local degraded mode
- **Stealth for macOS 15+**: Screen-share detection + masking (NSWindow.sharingType broken on Sequoia)
- **Latency budget**: ≤5s from question-end to first bullet, target 2.5-3.5s
